summary.text: Larry Walker III, a Republican, has represented Georgia's 20th Senate District since 2015 and serves as President Pro Tempore of the Senate; he was sworn in on December 18, 2015.

paragraphs.text: His official biography says he was born and raised in Perry, Georgia, and graduated from the University of Georgia's Terry College of Business.
The biography says he worked as a staff accountant for The Coca-Cola Company and for Walker Rhodes Tractor Company before founding Walker Insurance Agency in Perry.
